title: Insider Buys
method: Insider cluster buys from SEC Form 4 filings. Every Form 4 filed on EDGAR from 2026-09-14 to 2026-10-14 for US-listed issuers over $300M (8,160 filings) was read, keeping open-market purchases (transaction code P). A company qualifies when 3+ different insiders bought within the last 30 days, together spending more than $250K. Ranked by number of insiders buying, then dollars; up to 12 picks, the rest are backups.

rubric.how: 3 or more distinct reporting insiders with code-P purchases in the window
Shares × price as filed, summed across insiders: above $250,000
Market cap above $300M on Nasdaq's screener

dataNotes: Form 4 XML from SEC EDGAR (daily form indexes; only issuers in the $300M+ universe are fetched). Duplicate rows from joint filings and amendments are counted once. 154 companies had insider purchases; 16 met the insider/dollar test; 0 excluded as bitcoin miners or crypto-treasury companies; 2 left out because filed prices don't match the US share price (local-currency or other share class: BBD (avg filed price 17.97 vs US close 4.19), GAM (avg filed price 23.18 vs US close 64.85)). Prices are Nasdaq closes. Form 4s are due within 2 business days of the trade.

priceMismatch: BBD (avg filed price 17.97 vs US close 4.19)
GAM (avg filed price 23.18 vs US close 64.85)
